title: Chapter 475
text:
"What do you mean?"

Fausthod explained, "We are hiding in the dark, and Ovenn does not dare to show himself. Therefore, the enemy must be waiting for Godora's next wave of reinforcements. Our fleet is already waiting outside Noriose, and we can request for more space carriers to be sent. When the enemy's reinforcements arrive, they will receive Ovenn and leave Noriose. Then, our ambush troops will launch a surprise attack and directly attack the enemy's fleet. Not only can we get rid of the traitor, we can also destroy a Godora fleet and wipe them out in one fell swoop."

Anur was deep in thought. "That's right. The port is their only way out, and it will be easy to track them. This is a layer of insurance. However, we cannot relax because of this. Continue to look for Ovenn's real body and put pressure on them."

…

Han Xiao and the rest changed their stronghold and settled down. Only then did he formally discuss the plan with Nagojin and Ovenn. However, before the discussion, he had a question. Why did Ovenn betray Dark-star? There was no information about this person in his previous life.

"Betray? I don't think this is betrayal. " Ovenn stretched out his arm and shook his head. "I have golden skin. I am a Godora. This is abandoning the dark for the light. I joined Dark-star before, but this does not mean that I have to be a Dark-star member for life.

There are many mixed-bloods living in Godora. Like most people, I was discriminated against. Therefore, when a Dark-star member appeared in front of me, I did not hesitate to follow him. Dark-star recruits people through strict screening, and almost no Godora spy can sneak in. Naturally, I am not a spy. "

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and asked, "Then why did you side with Godora?"

"Because I noticed that the problem between Godora and Dark-star is not that simple. Dark-star has been instilling hatred in their members and creating a bad image of Godora, as if they want to kill all mixed-bloods. Dark-star members' impression of Godora has been distorted and worsened. The truth about Godora's situation is sealed."

Ovenn looked up and sighed. "Godora's attitude towards mixed-bloods is not extreme. The government is actually very open-minded. They only see Dark-star as an enemy. As for normal mixed-bloods, the government has always implemented fair policies to protect their rights."

Han Xiao nodded and joked. "I'll wait for you to say 'but'."

Alvin smiled bitterly. "Alright, but … policies can't change people's preconceived notions. The discrimination between purebloods and mixed-bloods is a deep-rooted tradition. The government might be able to provide us with material security, but discrimination is a personal freedom. The government can't control the thoughts of the people. Godora wants to accept mixed-bloods, but the enemies who obstruct the policies are their own citizens and their thousands of years of traditional thinking.

Furthermore, the existence of DarkStar exacerbated the conflict between races, making the purebloods discriminate against us even more. Even if the terrorists of DarkStar had nothing to do with the normal hybrids, it was unable to change the views of the majority. Not everyone could rationally choose between the facts and not the people.

Compared to the dangerous Dark-star, the mixed-bloods living in Godora are easy targets. Dark-star says that they are fighting for the mixed-bloods, but their unscrupulous actions not only failed to give the mixed-bloods a better life, but also made the mixed-bloods' lives worse … Thus, more mixed-bloods were forced to side with Dark-star.

This is a chain of influence that is difficult to unravel. You cannot expect pure bloods to not discriminate against us overnight, nor can you expect mixed-bloods to not resist discrimination. Dark-star is the key to all of this. Without Dark-star, mixed-bloods would not have suffered so much discrimination. "

Han Xiao tapped his finger on the table and looked at Nagojin. "What do you think?"

Nagojin sighed. "He is right. I do not discriminate against mixed-bloods, but I cannot represent everyone. The policy of the higher-ups has always been to treat mixed-bloods well and give them a chance to compete fairly. But because of Dark-star, the higher-ups are worried that mixed-bloods may betray them at any time and implicate them. Thus, it is almost impossible for mixed-bloods to climb to the top … You can understand it as class rigidity."

"The policy may be good, but a good plan may not be able to be implemented, especially under the premise that it affects the interests of individuals." Ovenn's expression was complicated. "That is why I am voluntarily siding with Godora. Perhaps only by getting rid of Dark-star can the mixed-bloods' lives truly improve."

Han Xiao looked at him and was filled with respect. "Your ambition … is very great."

"Thank you." Ovenn smiled and changed the topic. "But even if you praise me, I will not give you the information before it is completely safe."

"Don't say that to me. I don't care." Han Xiao smiled. "Save these words for the people of Godora. My mission is only to rescue you."

Han Xiao stopped smiling and said seriously, "We are not sure about Dark-star's next move for the time being. We have a few options now. The first is to hide and wait for reinforcements. This is the most passive way. The second is to take the initiative and fight with Dark-star to distract them so that they have no time to look for Ovenn's real body.

The third option requires Ovenn's consent. We will hide his real body somewhere far away from here, preferably on the other side of the planet. This way, his doppelgangers will disappear. Although he will be slightly injured, all the clues about Dark-star will be cut off. I know a teleportation mage living in Noriose who can help … if he doesn't mind that I beat him up.

The fourth option is to find an opportunity to quietly leave Noriose with his real body. This is very risky because there is a ninety percent chance that Dark-star's fleet is hiding in outer space. Leaving rashly is like a bug that has broken into a spider's web. "

Nagojin and Ovenn looked at each other and hesitated.

Han Xiao crossed his hands and supported his chin. He said in a low voice, "If there are no other suggestions, which one do you choose?"

With Nagojin's personality, he was more inclined to take the initiative to attack.

However, Ovenn did not seem to want to take the risk. He preferred to wait and see.

Bang.

Before the two of them could make up their minds, Aroshia's body suddenly swayed and hit the table with a loud bang.

They all turned around and saw her holding her forehead. Her eyes were out of focus and her eyebrows were tightly knitted, as if she was in pain.

"What's wrong?" Han Xiao immediately got up and put his hand on Aroshia's shoulder. He carefully looked at her face and asked in confusion.

Aroshia rubbed her temples and said with uncertainty, "It seems … there seems to be a voice in my head calling out to me. It seems to be getting closer and closer to me. I can feel its location …"

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, not understanding what was going on.

…

At the same time, a pitch-black spaceship that had experienced a long journey finally exited the hyperdrive state and floated in the starry universe.

It came from a distant star field, crossed countless stargates, was almost caught by a black hole, saw a supernova explosion, sailed through a quantum meteorite belt, escaped from space turbulence, encountered a radiation storm, and experienced an empty dark zone. It had been through countless difficulties and dangers along the way, and now it finally stopped.
